parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: A wooden drawer located under the tabletop, used for storage.
parts.Functional_description: It provides storage space for small items and slides in and out for access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves linearly along rails or grooves for opening and closing.

parts.name: Back Panel
parts.Basic_description: A wooden back panel that supports the rear structure of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural stability and prevents lateral movement.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden side panel on the left side of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the drawer and connects the tabletop to the legs.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Side Panel (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A vertical wooden side panel on the right side of the table frame.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the drawer and connects the tabletop to the legs.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Vertical Front Panel
parts.Basic_description: A front-facing wooden panel below the tabletop.
parts.Functional_description: It conceals the drawer and adds structural rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Front Right)
parts.Basic_description: A wooden leg supporting the front right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the tabletop and maintains balance.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Front Left)
parts.Basic_description: A wooden leg supporting the front left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the tabletop and maintains balance.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Back Right)
parts.Basic_description: A wooden leg supporting the back right corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the tabletop and maintains balance.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Leg (Back Left)
parts.Basic_description: A wooden leg supporting the back left corner of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the tabletop and maintains balance.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher (Front)
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden bar connecting the front legs.
parts.Functional_description: It increases stability and prevents leg splaying.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher (Back)
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden bar connecting the back legs.
parts.Functional_description: It increases stability and prevents leg splaying.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher (Left Side)
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden bar connecting the left legs.
parts.Functional_description: It reinforces the table structure and prevents wobbling.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher (Right Side)
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden bar connecting the right legs.
parts.Functional_description: It reinforces the table structure and prevents wobbling.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Bar Stretcher (Center)
parts.Basic_description: A central horizontal wooden bar connecting front and back stretchers.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional structural support and rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Tabletop
parts.Basic_description: A flat wooden surface forming the top of the table.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main working or placing surface of the table.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.
